name: Player_Update
note: keys only: tow start; autothrottle; briefing; pause; abort; look/follow; eject; gear; hover switch (flight model is inlined in Game_Run 0x1ea8c)

name: Player_GliderUpdate
note: was Camera_Update/Player_HoverUpdate: glider speed (no thrust) + ridge lift 0x90580; called when 0x90594

name: Player_DrawHeli
note: was Player_Collide: queues body+rotor sprites from the .HD table (0x84a34); no collision; rotor offset always from record 0

name: Tanker_Update
note: was Player_Ejection: air-to-air refuelling tanker; fuel transfer at the probe (stats 109/110)

name: SupportAircraft_Update
note: was Player_DeathAndLanding: tow plane; Fat Albert; B52; ship; campaign bomber + lock-on; player flare shells; ground pickup/winch

name: Carrier_Update
note: was Player_LandingCheck: catapult countdown and taxi-to-catapult; called by Mission_CheckComplete

name: Player_DamageSystems
note: armour loss and random system failure (16 handlers below)

name: Hud_LampBlinkA
note: DISPLAY 2 FAIL: draws a shift-bank sprite at the panel position of sprite 0x8c

name: Player_RotateA
note: Up: g_Dir -= turn rate; heli: collective up

name: Player_RotateB
note: Down: g_Dir += turn rate; heli: collective down

name: Player_PitchDown
note: clears brake drag; plane: ThrottleDown; heli: g_HeliVX -= 2

name: Player_ThrottleDown
note: throttle -2; at 0 on the ground: brakes or reverse thrust

name: Player_TakeoffAssist
note: fire held with gear down: auto throttle to rotate speed; nose levelling

name: Player_FullPower
note: FULL POWER STUPID; throttle 9 (backseat driver while stalling)

name: Player_PullUp
note: PULL UP STUPID ground warning (0x901bc) with backseat driver

name: Player_EngineFire
note: engine shake; spiral at fire level 3; death at >3

name: Player_GearCollapseRoll
note: hard landing while stalling: Rand(5)==1 gear fails

name: Player_AfterburnerFlame
note: 3 flame sprites (double math; twin engines stat 66)

name: Hud_DrawBriefing
note: B key held >8 frames: briefing text overlay

name: Hud_DrawPanel
note: display.pax; weapon icons; lives; damage lamps; terrain profile; counters; radar markers

name: Hud_UpdateRadar
note: radar/Jammed; speed bar; fuel; dots; colour pulses; altimeter; score; kill medals; lamps

name: Hud_DrawTargetArrow
note: sprite 0xa7 clamped to the screen if target within 0x4b0

name: Hud_DrawMessages
note: centred rows at y 0x2e+8*row; expiry shifts

name: Hud_WeaponMessage
note: builds rack messages then Hud_Nop (nothing shown)

name: Stub_LaunchCountdown
note: empty; receives STANDBY TO LAUNCH n

name: g_StallSink
note: stall counter added to the wanted vy

name: g_StallTopY
note: highest PY since the stall (9999 none)

name: g_AutoThrottle
note: was g_TrainingMode: toggled by Tab with AUTOTHROTTLE ON/OFF; enables 0x152a0

name: g_KillTallyValue
note: was g_RadarScales: medal values 1 5 10 25 50 75 100 for the kill tally
